image_prompt.text: Pillars and columns scattered across the arena floor alongside low walls, giving tactical cover and breaking line of sight so a retreating fighter can drop combat lock
a solid boundary wall running the full perimeter of the arena, tall enough to keep fighters inside the fighting space
stairs and ramps connecting the flat central platform to the raised side platforms at each height

notes: Preset caveat: Platform Fighter taken with its own arena-tiered shape, but hazard-kill dropped — the prompt asks for a perimeter wall that keeps fighters in, which is the opposite of ring-out edges.

Close shape call: arena-stacked was considered for the 'vertical combat' wording and rejected — raised side platforms joined by stairs and ramps are terraced relief with nothing overhanging, so the build stays on P0 + tiered rather than P2.
The tiered elevation is earned, not assumed: the prompt explicitly asks for raised side platforms at different heights.

Prompt requests configurable attributes ArenaSize, PlatformHeight, WallHeight, PrimaryColor and AccentColor, plus a sturdy look with a mix of materials. These are build parameters and styling rather than layout features, so nothing in the handoff can carry them.

would have asked: offered the Platform Fighter layout — a terraced combat arena with a large flat central platform, raised side platforms at different heights, stairs and ramps between the levels, scattered line-of-sight pillars and low cover, and a perimeter boundary wall instead of the usual ring-out edges. That elevation makes it a tiered build rather than a flat one. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?
would have asked: whether anti-camp spawn placement is wanted — the prompt never says where fighters enter, so spawn-protected was not added.
would have asked: anything else you want in the space?
